title: The "CloudTop": AI-driven Marketing and Service Intelligentized Applications of China Telecom Cloud
summary: China Telecom Cloud reports quality-inspection coverage rising from 10% to 100%, 24% better service efficiency, and 30% fewer night shifts.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: CloudTop is in production across China Telecom Cloud’s service and marketing workflows. The submission reports broader quality inspection, improved service efficiency, and reduced night shifts. These operational and workforce figures are first-party claims. Wider employment-equity and economic-growth effects are not measured.
purpose: Automate service support, quality inspection, and marketing workflows.
developer: China Telecom Cloud Technology Co., Ltd.

ratings.reason: China Telecom Cloud reports that production use expanded knowledge/quality-inspection coverage from 10% to 100%, with 24% better service efficiency.
The deployer reports 30% fewer night shifts, a concrete workforce scheduling improvement without evidence of a deeper or lasting personal outcome.
Employment equity and wider economic growth are proposed effects, without a measured community change.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 6: The "CloudTop": AI-driven Marketing and Service Intelligentized Applications of China Telecom Cloud

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: CloudTop expands quality inspection and customer-service support

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
